name: retrieve_and_halve_value

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1BF9A

name: lookup_ranged_32bit_value

name: lookup_rotated_index_entry

name: lookup_rotated_index_entry_low

name: compute_column_dot_product_pair
description: Multiplies a register vector with three matrix elements taken at a stride of three, for each of two columns, doubles both sums, and returns them packed as a 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D028
name: compute_row_dot_product_pair
description: Multiplies a register vector with two consecutive rows of three matrix elements in memory, doubles both sums, and returns them packed as a 64-bit value.

description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two register angles in a table, applying sign handling from the angle quadrant, then stores products of these values into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with the last element zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D084

description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two angles passed on the stack and two register angles through a table, then stores products of these values into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with the last element zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D0A6

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D0C8
name: build_rotation_matrix_two_lookups
description: Looks up two table values from register angles, combines them with two further register values, and stores the products into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with the last element zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D0E6
name: build_rotation_matrix
description: Looks up one table value from a register angle, combines it with two register values, and stores the products into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with the last element zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D140
name: build_negated_rotation_matrix
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two register angles in a table, then stores products into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with several elements negated and the last element zeroed.

name: build_negated_matrix_stack_angles
description: Looks up sine and cosine values for two stack-passed angles and two register angles in a table, then stores products into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with several elements negated and the last element zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D186
name: build_negated_matrix_mixed_inputs
description: Looks up one table value from a register angle, combines it with a second register value and two stack-passed table values, and stores negated products into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with the last element zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D1A8
name: build_negated_matrix_two_lookups
description: Looks up two table values from register angles, combines them with two further register values, and stores negated products into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with the last element zeroed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D1C6
name: build_inverse_rotation_matrix
description: Looks up one table value from a register angle, combines it with three register values, and stores products into a 3x3 matrix in the output array with several elements negated, giving the inverse of a rotation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D224
name: compute_trig_product_pair
description: Looks up sine-like values for two register angles in a table, applying sign handling from the angle's upper bits, and returns two products of these values packed into a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D246
name: compute_signed_table_product_pair
description: Looks up two table values and multiplies one of them by a signed register value, returning that product and a second table product packed as a 64-bit result.

name: compute_scaled_table_product_pair
description: Multiplies a register value by a table entry, doubles the product, and returns it together with a second product of two table-derived values packed into a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D286
name: compute_register_table_product_pair
description: Multiplies two register values, doubles the product, and returns it together with a second product of one register value and a signed table entry, packed as a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D2A4
name: compute_vector_component
description: Multiplies two register values, doubles the product, and combines it with a product of a register value and a table entry into a 64-bit result.

name: clip_line_to_bounds

name: step_line_to_limit
description: Steps a fixed-point line toward its far endpoint in subpixel increments until a coordinate reaches a limit of 168 or a large fixed-point threshold, returning the clipped position.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D39A
name: step_fixed_point_pair
description: Advances two fixed-point accumulators by halving step sizes in a loop until the second step falls below a threshold, then returns both accumulators' integer parts.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D3C8
name: clip_line_to_bounds_mirrored
description: Steps a fixed-point line in the opposite direction to its neighbours, handling negative slopes and stopping at the limits of 169 or a large fixed-point threshold.

name: rotate_vector_pair_by_angle
description: Rotates two sets of three 16-bit components in place using a sine-like value taken from a table at a register angle and a cosine derived from the same table at a quarter-turn offset.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D924
name: rotate_pair_by_two_angles
description: Rotates two sets of three 16-bit components in place, taking the sine-like value from a table at one register index and the cosine from a second register angle offset by a quarter turn.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1D946
name: rotate_vector_pair_direct
description: Rotates two sets of three 16-bit components in place, using a register value directly as one coefficient and a table entry at an indexed offset as the other.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1DC1E
name: insert_tree_node
description: Descends a binary tree from its global root by comparing keys, moving to the left or right child at each step, and attaches the new node as a leaf with cleared child links.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1DC36
name: attach_tree_node_from_root
description: Inserts a new node into a binary tree starting from the given node by comparing keys, attaching it at the first empty child link and clearing its child pointers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1DC70
name: init_tree_root_node
description: Sets the tree's root node to a zeroed key and empty child links, then stores fixed starting values into the global state variables.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1DC74
name: reset_tree_root_node
description: Clears the tree root's key and child links, then restores the same fixed starting global values as the tree initialisation routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1DCC8
name: set_global_pointers_to_stack
description: Stores the address of a local stack buffer into three global pointer variables.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1DCE4
name: walk_tree_calling_handlers
description: Walks a tree of linked records by following child links and calls a handler, found through an indexed table, for records visited on the way down and back up. Its entry is only reached as gap data, so it may not be a live routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1DCEE
name: walk_tree_from_global_root
description: Walks a tree starting from a root pointer held in a global variable, calling a handler for each record through an indexed table on the way down and again on the way back up.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E3E4
name: stub_empty_return
description: The routine contains only an immediate return, so it has no behaviour beyond returning to its caller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E3E6
name: update_cached_matrix_product
description: When the object's cached generation byte differs from the global one, it multiplies the object's 3x3 matrix by a second 3x3 matrix returned by a called routine, stores two resulting matrices in the object, and records the new generation byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E510
name: accumulate_transformed_position
description: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix by a vector after shifting it to fit, then adds the result to a 64-bit accumulator stored in the object with carry propagation, and updates the object's generation byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E56E
name: accumulate_transformed_params
description: Shifts register and stack inputs to fit, multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix, adds the result to three 64-bit parameter values with carry propagation, stores the sums in the object, and updates its generation byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E5E8
name: store_shifted_accumulated_values
description: Shifts three register values by a variable amount, adds them to parameters and stack values, and stores the sums with carry flags into the object along with its generation byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E634
name: get_cached_transformed_result
description: Returns the object's cached 64-bit result when its generation byte matches the global one; otherwise it recomputes the result from the object's 3x3 matrix and a source vector, stores it, and records the new generation byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E63A
name: get_cached_result_reg_gen
description: Returns the object's cached 64-bit result when a generation byte passed in a register matches the stored one; otherwise it recomputes the result from the object's 3x3 matrix and a source vector, stores it, and updates the generation byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E68A
name: read_cached_result_pair
description: Returns the 64-bit cached result stored in the object without recalculating it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E692
name: copy_source_fields_to_result
description: Copies six 32-bit source fields of the object into its result fields and sets the object's generation byte to the global value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E69C
name: compare_and_subtract_record_positions
description: Compares two records' flag bytes and, when they match, returns the difference of their stored position fields; when they differ it either negates one record's position or subtracts the other record's cached position from a helper result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E6D0
name: subtract_record_positions
description: Returns the difference of two records' stored position fields when their flag bytes match; otherwise it subtracts one record's cached position from a helper result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E6FE
name: negate_and_concat_a3_fields
description: Reads two 32-bit integers from fixed fields of the A3 record, negates both values, and combines them into a single 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E712
name: store_shifted_fields_and_call
description: Stores a shifted 16-bit field value and the high byte of another field into the working area, then calls a helper routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E736
name: store_byte_and_call
description: Extracts the high byte of a 16-bit field from one structure, stores it into another structure, and then calls a helper routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E756
name: compute_bitmask_and_store
description: Computes a one-bit mask from the difference between a register value and a field in a record, clamps it to a signed byte, and stores the result with a constant pair of 16-bit sentinels into another record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E772
name: compute_projected_record_fields
description: Applies a 3x3 matrix to a vector shifted by a computed amount, stores the resulting values and a bitmask-derived byte into the object's fields, and when the result passes a threshold, writes a draw command byte into an output buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E7E2
name: compute_transformed_record_fields
description: Shifts a source vector by a computed amount, derives a scale from a record field, and applies a 3x3 matrix taken from one of two records to produce rotated values stored in the target record, writing a bitmask byte and sentinel values when the scale is out of range. The recovered pseudo-code is truncated, so only the start of the routine is described.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E84C
name: transform_record_with_matrix
description: Multiplies a source vector by a 3x3 matrix taken from a record, applies shifts and sign handling, stores the results in a target record with sentinel values, and calls helpers to finish the update.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E934
name: multiply_record_matrix_pair
description: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix held in a sub-record of the object by the 3x3 matrix at the caller's pointer, storing the nine products in the working area and then calling a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1E93A
name: multiply_record_matrix_with_flag
description: When the record's flag byte is set, calls a helper and advances its matrix pointer, then multiplies the record's 3x3 matrix by a second matrix, storing the nine products in the working area.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1EA8E
name: copy_or_multiply_record_matrix
description: Sets two sentinel values in the target record, then either copies nine values from the source record into the working area or multiplies them with the target's matrix, depending on the two records' flag bytes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1EA9A
name: flush_pending_command_byte
description: When a pending flag is set, writes the value 30 into the output buffer, advances the buffer pointer and clears the flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1EAA6
name: update_global_pointer_state
description: Calls helpers, then if a pending flag is set writes a constant byte to the output pointer, advances that pointer and clears the flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1EB32
name: flush_pending_command_and_return
description: Calls helpers, then if a pending flag is set writes a constant byte to the output pointer, advances it, clears the flag and returns early.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1EBC6
name: normalize_and_transform_vectors
description: Computes a common right-shift that brings three 32-bit values into a 16-bit range, stores the shift count and shifted values in the working area, then applies matrix products to the shifted values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1ECC6
name: compute_visibility_margin
description: Compares the absolute values of two components against a shifted record field and a threshold, returning the remaining margin, or zero when the values fall outside the range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1ED02
name: clear_strided_table_words
description: Zeroes words of a table at fixed strides, with the number of rows derived from a record field, first in blocks of ten rows and then one row at a time. It is only reached as gap data.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1ED10
name: clear_structured_memory
description: Zeroes five fixed fields of a local structure, then clears words of a table at a fixed stride, with the number of rows derived from a register input.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1F68C
name: fill_stack_with_constant
description: Writes the constant 32896 repeatedly into a stack buffer, with the count derived from a field of a record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FD0C
name: cull_sprite_to_screen_bounds
description: Checks a point and its half-extent against screen limits of 319 horizontally and 167 vertically, returning early when it lies outside them, and otherwise passes the on-screen point on to a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FD26
name: cull_sprite_to_vertical_bounds
description: Returns early when a point and its extent fall outside the horizontal or vertical limits of 167, otherwise passes the visible point on to helper routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FD42
name: emit_sprite_with_attribute_flags
description: Returns early when a point lies outside the limits, otherwise builds a sprite attribute word from flag bits in a register and a stored offset, then writes it through helper calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FDAC
name: init_sprite_record_and_slot
description: Writes seven fixed words into a sprite record, then allocates a four-byte slot from a global table, recording its index, or stores nothing further when the table is full.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FDB0
name: init_sprite_record_with_slots
description: Writes the same fixed sprite words as its sibling routine, then allocates slots from a global table for the sprite using values passed on the stack, returning zero when no room remains.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FE18
name: allocate_slot_entry_indexed
description: Allocates a four-byte slot from a global table when space remains, storing its index in the caller's byte array and in a record field, then allocates a second slot indexed by the sum of two values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FE2A
name: append_slot_index_and_allocate
description: Writes a byte and a word into an index table, increments the table's count, records the value in a record field, and allocates a further four-byte slot from the global table when room remains.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FE5A
name: allocate_slot_entry_for_record
description: Allocates a four-byte slot from the global table and stores its index in a record field, then combines two stored values with a helper's result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FE6C
name: emit_scaled_sprite_record
description: Writes an index byte and word into a table and records a field, then derives a scaled size by dividing a shifted value by a helper result, and writes the sprite values to the output.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FF88
name: emit_sprite_at_decremented_point
description: Decrements the two point coordinates, then uses flag bits and a scaled value obtained by shifting to write sprite attributes through the output pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FF94
name: build_masked_sprite_attributes
description: Builds a masked attribute word from register flags and a stored offset, decrements the point coordinates, and writes sprite attributes through helper calls when the flag byte is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FFF6
name: write_sprite_header_record
description: Writes a sprite header word of 374, or 442 when a flag is set, followed by the adjusted coordinates and a fixed value, then allocates a slot from the global table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:1FFFA
name: write_sprite_header_with_slots
description: Writes a sprite header word of 374, or 442 when a flag is set, with adjusted coordinates and a fixed value, then allocates slots through further helper calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2005C
name: allocate_masked_slot_entry
description: Stores a byte and a word in a slot table, then allocates a further slot indexed by a masked and shifted register value and records its index in an output field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2006E
name: allocate_masked_slot_index_pair
description: Writes a byte and a word into an index table, records the word in a record field, and allocates or reuses a slot indexed by a masked and shifted register value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:200A2
name: allocate_slot_entry_at_record
description: Allocates a four-byte slot from the global table when room remains and stores its index in a record field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:200B4
name: append_index_entry
description: Writes a byte and a word into an index table, advances the table's count, and stores the word in a record field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:200C8
name: emit_zero_scale_sprite_record
description: Computes a scale by dividing a shifted value by a shifted extent, and when the quotient is zero writes a sprite record with code word 1272 and the scaled fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:200E0
name: emit_divided_sprite_record
description: Divides a shifted value by an extent, and when the quotient is zero writes a sprite record with code word 1272 and the scaled fields, taking the position from a helper result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:20116
name: emit_scaled_sprite_with_flag
description: When a flag byte is set, computes a division-based scale from a stored value, then writes a sprite record whose position comes from a helper result, allocating slot entries depending on whether the scale is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:20148
name: write_sprite_record_and_slot
description: Writes a sprite record with code word 1272, a helper-derived value and two fields, then allocates a four-byte slot from the global table when room remains.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2014C
name: write_sprite_record_multi_call
description: Writes a sprite record with code word 1272 and fields from helper results, then allocates a slot from the global table through further helper calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2019C
name: allocate_slot_entry_into_field
description: Allocates a four-byte slot from the global table when room remains, storing the index in a record field and writing a byte into the index table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:201AE
name: store_index_entry_word
description: Writes a byte and a word into an index table, advances the table's count, and stores the word in a record field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:21AFE
name: select_lookup_source_word
description: Reads a source word and uses it directly when a flag bit is clear; otherwise it picks a pair of lookup-table values by bits of a second word, combines them with stored record values, and calls a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:21C1E
name: fetch_shifted_table_value
description: Reads a word, either shifting its bits or fetching it from one of two tables depending on bit 7, then combines it with a value selected from a small table indexed by a register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:21C2A
name: lookup_signed_table_component
description: Looks up a word from a record table or a stack area depending on bit 7 of an index, then applies sign handling from a second table lookup to produce a signed component.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:21C3C
name: lookup_signed_sin_cos_pair
description: Reads an angle word, looks up sine-like and cosine-like values from a table with sign handling and a quarter-turn offset, and returns the pair to the caller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:21C68
name: combine_frame_values_with_table
description: Looks up a table value and a sign-handled sine-like value, then multiplies them with stored frame values to produce a combined result that is written back into the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:21C8A
name: transform_frame_values_with_table
description: Multiplies pairs of stored frame values by a table value and a register value, doubles each product, and writes the high words back into the frame.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:22152
name: return_constant_255
description: Returns the constant 255 to its caller with no other effect.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2371C
name: decompile_timeout_routine
description: No pseudo-code was recovered because decompilation timed out, so its behaviour cannot be described from this evidence. It has 31 instructions, has its address taken, is called by two routines and calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:237C6
name: setup_frame_from_record_block
description: Computes pointers to two sub-blocks of a record and negated coordinate words, stores them in the frame, and adjusts a shifted count when it is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:237D0
name: setup_frame_with_stored_pointer
description: Stores a caller-supplied pointer and negated coordinate words in the frame, then adjusts a shifted count when it is nonzero, and calls helper routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23C22
name: dispatch_handler_by_index
description: Calls a handler selected from a jump table by an index derived from the register argument.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23DB2
name: start_stream_decode_or_dispatch
description: Dispatches to a handler through a pointer table when the register value's high bit is set; otherwise it selects a base pointer and starts decoding a byte stream into the output buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23DC6
name: decode_stream_from_table
description: Copies bytes from a compressed stream into an output buffer until a zero byte, expanding escape bytes above 252: 255 calls a helper, 254 writes 31 followed by a value, and 253 writes 30 followed by a value. The stream start comes from a table entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23DCE
name: decode_stream_from_offset
description: Copies bytes from a compressed stream into an output buffer until a zero byte, expanding escape bytes above 252: 255 calls a helper, 254 writes 31 followed by a value, and 253 writes 30 followed by a value. The stream start is an offset from the caller's base pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23DDA
name: decode_stream_into_buffer
description: Expands escape bytes above 252 in a compressed byte stream while copying it to the output, writing 31 for byte 254 and 30 for the other escapes, and calls a helper for byte 255.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23DE6
name: decode_stream_from_register_byte
description: Starts a stream copy from a register byte: 255 calls a helper, 254 writes 31 with two following bytes, and other escapes write 30 with one following byte, then copies bytes until a zero byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23DF8
name: decode_stream_with_leading_code
description: Writes 30 followed by the first source byte, then copies a compressed stream with the same escape expansion until a zero byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23E00
name: decode_stream_after_helper
description: Calls a helper first, then copies a compressed stream with the same escape expansion until a zero byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23E12
name: dispatch_handler_by_shifted_index
description: Calls a handler selected from a jump table by a shifted register index.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23E22
name: wrap_text_at_spaces
description: Scans a text buffer using a per-character width table, and when a character would exceed the remaining width it searches back to the previous space and replaces that space with the value 13 to break the line.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:23E60
name: stub_empty_return
description: The routine contains only an immediate return, so it has no behaviour beyond returning to its caller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24AD2
name: init_state_block_fields
description: Clears a set of state bytes and words in the state block, sets a sentinel of minus one, and continues with a long sequence of operations. Only the start of the truncated pseudo-code is recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24AD8
name: init_state_block_active
description: Like its sibling, sets state fields in the block with the flag byte set to 255 instead of zero, then performs a long sequence of operations. Only the start of the truncated pseudo-code is recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24B2C
name: update_state_block_flags
description: When a flag byte is set, calls a helper and stores a sentinel of 65535 in the state block, then reads further state bytes and calls helpers. The recovered pseudo-code is truncated.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24B94
name: find_next_valid_entity
description: Repeatedly fetches a pair of entities from helper routines and counts down through a table of entity descriptors, returning once the compared flag and type fields match and calling the helper again for the next pair otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24BDE
name: combine_record_fixed_point_fields
description: Combines several fixed-point fields of two records with carry-aware arithmetic, calls helper routines, and returns a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24C4A
name: compute_pair_status_byte
description: Computes a status byte from fixed-point fields of two records and returns it to the caller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24C6E
name: multiply_fixed_point_bitwise
description: Performs a bit-by-bit fixed-point multiply over its parameters using shifts and conditional adds, then returns a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24DDE
name: apply_rotation_and_scale
description: Copies fixed-point parameters into the output record, calls three helper routines, and combines their results with shifts to produce scaled values stored in the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24EDC
name: divide_fixed_point_restoring
description: Performs a restoring division loop on a fixed-point value, sets a status bit in the global state, and returns the quotient.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24F44
name: return_zero
description: Returns zero to its caller with no other effect.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:24F4C
name: scan_table_records_for_match
description: Clears a state byte, looks up a record through an index stored in another record, and scans a table of word records with comparisons, calling helpers as it goes. The recovered pseudo-code is truncated.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2504E
name: damp_and_negate_record_fields
description: Negates three record fields after dividing each by four, then calls a handler through a function pointer when a count field exceeds 16, and returns the status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2508C
name: step_record_state_machine
description: Loops over a state byte, copying a record's flag and a status byte into the global state when a pending flag is set, and calls helpers until its loop condition clears.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:250FC
name: return_state_status_byte
description: Returns the status byte stored in the global state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:25106
name: interpret_record_bytecode
description: Reads command bytes from a record's bytecode stream, combines operands with helper results, and updates the record's state bytes. Only part of the routine is recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:251B0
name: combine_record_fields_long
description: Reads several 16-bit fields from two records, combines them with a helper result into a 48-bit value, and returns it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:251CC
name: evaluate_record_field_sum
description: Reads several 16-bit fields from a record, combines them with arithmetic and helper results, and returns a 48-bit value. Part of the routine is recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:25250
name: read_bytecode_flag_block
description: Reads bytes from a command stream while the high bit is set, storing each following byte in a record field, and returns a fixed sentinel when the stream ends.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2525A
name: dispatch_bytecode_command
description: Checks a mask bit, then reads command bytes from a stream: commands with the top bit set call a helper with an operand and update the record, and other bytes are stored in the state.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:25290
name: return_constant_long
description: Returns the fixed 64-bit value 4294967296, which is 1 shifted left by 32 bits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2529E
name: skip_command_string_with_state
description: Reads bytes from a command stream until a zero byte, calling helpers for each one, then sets the top bit of a state byte and returns a fixed sentinel.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:252B2
name: skip_command_string
description: Reads bytes from a command stream until a zero byte, calling a helper for each one, and returns a fixed sentinel.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:252C6
name: dispatch_flagged_bytecode_command
description: Reads command bytes from a stream: when the bit with value 64 is clear it calls a helper with the operand and ORs the result into a state byte, otherwise it processes the next command. Several helpers are called.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2530A
name: read_bytecode_command_stream
description: Reads command bytes from a stream, ORing the low seven bits of each into a state byte and dispatching commands, and returns a fixed sentinel when the stream ends.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:25316
name: compute_record_delta_values
description: Computes differences between record fields and a helper result, storing intermediate values in a local array, and returns a 64-bit status. Only part of the routine is recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:25386
name: shift_record_fields_conditionally
description: When the condition flag is not set, shifts a register value by a count taken from another register, then calls helpers to update records.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:253A8
name: lookup_record_table_pair
description: Looks up two table values indexed by the low bits of a register, adjusts them using a flag bit, and calls helpers to update a record.
